title: On Confirming the date by letter
subtitle: 数据统计 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 数据统计（科学与技术·数据与统计）
meta: 主题语境：数据统计（科学与技术·数据与统计）　|　核心词汇：confirm　|　正文 329 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 confirm 的形式与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1970 the driver ① confirmed the date by letter in silence, and every passenger in the station said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there. Three days on, people still spoke of how quietly it was done and of how, ever since, the driver ② confirms the date by letter twice over without being asked. My mother said later that to ③ confirm the date by letter at all was the part nobody had expected.

By then somebody had surely ④ confirmed the date by letter before — a line in the timetable for February 1964 hints at it — but nobody could name the person. ⑤ Confirming the date by letter in silence, the driver said once, is nine parts patience and one part nerve; it is not the doing of it that people remember.

My uncle, who kept the ticket at the far platform, meant the other thing entirely. He said that if anybody should ever ⑥ confirm what everybody already feared twice over, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again. The rule the old hands handed down was plainer still: ⑦ Confirm what everybody already feared at once and never mention it again.

By 1977 the whole business had shrunk to half a line in the timetable, and a new passenger from the next station ⑧ confirms what everybody already feared in silence every day without once asking what it had cost the first time. My mother, who had watched all of it from the platform, said nothing at all; she simply ⑨ confirmed the date by letter again when nobody else would.

⑩ To confirm the date by letter, my mother said in 1982, is not one thing but two: what you do and what the station remembers of it. She said the second half never grows lighter, and nowadays, whenever the station forgets, somebody confirms the date by letter twice over again and somebody must confirm the date by letter in silence all over again.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. v. 确认（一般过去式 confirmed the date by letter：1970 年司机头一回这样做，一言不发地）
B. v. 确认（一般现在 confirms the date by letter：自那以后成了老习惯，不必有人开口）
C. v. 确认（不定式 to confirm the date by letter：文中两处，一是母亲说的“难就难在……”，一是结尾那句格言）
D. v. 确认（过去完成时 had confirmed the date by letter：1964 年二月的时刻表上那行字之前就有人做过）
E. v. 确认（动名词 confirming the date by letter 作主语：“九分耐心、一分胆气”那一句）
F. v. 证实（confirm what everybody already feared：should ever 之后的原形，指万一真要去证实证实了人人已经担心的事）
G. v. 证实（confirm what everybody already feared：祈使句，转述老手们当年立下的那条规矩）
H. v. 确认（后段两处：新来的乘客照例 confirms what everybody already feared，而母亲又一次 confirmed the date by letter）

items.q: to confirm the date by letter
confirmed the date by letter before
confirm what everybody already feared twice over
confirm what everybody already feared at once

to confirm the date by letter

answers.why: confirm 意为“确认”，1970 年司机一言不发地确认写信确认日期，那是车站里头一回有人肯这么做，故用一般过去式 confirmed。
confirm 意为“确认”，自那以后司机来回两遍把这件事做了一遍又一遍，不必有人开口，故用一般现在 confirms。
confirm 意为“确认”，母亲说的是“难就难在肯确认写信确认日期”，此处为不定式 to confirm the date by letter。
confirm 意为“确认”，时刻表里 二月 那行字说明早在 1977 年之前就有人确认过，故用过去完成时 had confirmed。
confirm 意为“确认”，司机说“确认写信确认日期这件事是九分耐心一分胆气”，此处 confirming the date by letter 作主语。
confirm 意为“证实”，叔叔说的是“万一真有人去证实证实了人人已经担心的事”，should ever 之后用原形 confirm what everybody already feared。
confirm 意为“证实”，老手们留下的规矩是祈使句：立刻证实证实了人人已经担心的事（confirm what everybody already feared at once），以后再也不要提起。
confirm 意为“确认”，新来的乘客每个日子都照例证实证实了人人已经担心的事，从不问头一回的代价，用一般现在 confirms。
confirm 意为“确认”，母亲在无人肯做的时候又一次一言不发地确认写信确认日期，用一般过去式 confirmed 叙述。
confirm 意为“确认”，结尾那句是母亲 1982 年的话：要确认写信确认日期，其实不是一件事，而是两件事——你做的那一件，和车站记住的那一件。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1970 年，司机一言不发地确认写信确认日期；车站里每一个乘客都说这是头一回。（confirmed the date by letter）
多年以后，司机仍来回两遍做着同一件事，不必有人开口。（confirms the date by letter）
母亲后来说，难就难在肯确认写信确认日期这件事本身。（to confirm the date by letter）
早在 1964 年就有人确认写信确认日期，二月那天时刻表上的一行字就是证据。（had confirmed the date by letter）
司机说过，一言不发地确认写信确认日期这件事，是九分耐心一分胆气。（confirming the date by letter 作主语）
老手们留下的规矩说得明白：立刻证实证实了人人已经担心的事，以后再也不要提起。（confirm what everybody already feared，祈使句）
answers: In 1970 the driver confirmed the date by letter in silence, and every passenger in the station said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there.
Three days on, the driver still confirms the date by letter twice over without being asked.
My mother said later that to confirm the date by letter at all was the part nobody had expected.
Somebody had confirmed the date by letter long before 1977, and the line in the timetable for February proves it.
Confirming the date by letter in silence, the driver said once, is nine parts patience and one part nerve.
The rule the old hands handed down was plain: Confirm what everybody already feared at once and never mention it again.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 confirm 的 3 种不同形式（过去式、第三人称、-ing、不定式等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1970 the driver confirmed the date by letter in silence, and nobody in the station forgot it.
Even now the driver confirms the date by letter twice over whenever the station asks.
Confirming the date by letter in silence, my mother used to say, is nine parts patience and one part nerve.
If anybody should ever confirm what everybody already feared twice over, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again.
A new passenger from the next station confirms what everybody already feared in silence every day, asking nothing about the past.
When nobody else would, my mother confirmed the date by letter again, and the station remembered that half.
